synopsis: In Chinjuku, the city that never sleeps, there is a psychic senior police officer who has powers beyond human comprehension! His name is Meguru Choujou! Along with his judo expert partner Nao Ippongi, this hilarious duo will keep the streets clean by any means necessary!  (Source: MANGA Plus)

title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica: Prima Aurora
japanese_title: BanG Dream! Ave Mujica prima aurora
synopsis: More than half a year has passed since Ave Mujica's comeback, and spring has arrived. The band's popularity continues to grow, while each member's individual activities are also gaining momentum. The next venue Sakiko proposes is a members-only masquerade ball.  What lies behind the intentions of the girl who swore to become a god...?  (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Romelia Senki
synopsis: Rising from the ashes, a fallen noblewoman stands to save humanity!  After the Demon King's defeat, Countess Romelia's world is shattered when Prince Henri, her fiancé, publicly breaks off their engagement, dismissing her as "useless" alongside his new allies: Saint Elizabeth, the sage Ekaterina, and the swordswoman Lu Hime. What they don't realize is that Romelia possesses a secret power called "Grace," which brings her extraordinary luck. Left abandoned and humiliated, Romelia refuses to give up. With her homeland still under siege by the remnants of the demon army and her people enslaved, she embarks on a desperate mission to save them.  Facing overwhelming challenges—no army, no healers, no funds, and only inexperienced recruits—Romelia uses her wit and determination to turn the odds in her favor. She seizes fortresses from local lords to build her forces, negotiates with the church for healing, secures funds from merchants, and has her soldiers gain experience through monster hunting. Against all expectations, Romelia rises from the ashes, leading her loyal followers in a daring campaign to rescue her people and prove her worth.  (Source: MAL News)

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
english_title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life
japanese_title: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
synopsis: Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points!  With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!  (Source: Shochiku)

title: Tank Chair
synopsis: Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!  (Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hotel Inhumans 2nd Season
japanese_title: ホテル・インヒューマンズ 第2期
synopsis: Second season of Hotel Inhumans.

title: #Zombie Sagashitemasu
synopsis: Set in a world where 90% of humanity has contracted and died from a deadly, virulent disease, only to rise again as attacking zombies, thirteen years have passed since the "Red Day" of societal collapse. The surviving humans now live away from the big cities, still hoping to reclaim them one day. An entirely new generation, unaware of the pre-Red Day world, is coming into its own.  The story begins when Aki, who has no memories of the world before its fall, escapes her village with her close friends Haru and Natsuki to search for her missing father. As they venture into the outside world, they find themselves surrounded by zombies on all sides! Along the way, they rescue Yuu and Sakura and take refuge in a home improvement store. They regroup, and now the counterattack begins—!!  (Source: Kadokawa, edited)

title: Sekai Saikyou no Majo, Hajimemashita
japanese_title: 世界最強の魔女、始めました
synopsis: When Lorna manifests a completely useless ability, she's labeled an embarrassment to her family and kicked out of the house. With no money or food, she's about to hit rock bottom. But then, she figures out how to use her supposedly worthless SSS-Rank skill, "Internet." This cheat-level talent gives her the know-how to gather an unlimited amount of valuable items and easily acquire rare equipment. Armed with godlike knowledge, Lorna's free to do anything she wants! If only she could figure out what "lmfao" means...  (Source: Yen Press)

title: Kashita Maryoku wa "Revo Barai" de Kyousei Choushuu
japanese_title: 貸した魔力は【リボ払い】で強制徴収
synopsis: Lent is part of the up-and-coming party known as the "Skypiercers," and thanks to his unique Gift, he can loan massive amounts of magic to others. No MP? No problem with Lent around! Except, now that his companions have become formidable heroes (thanks to his skill), his usefulness is questioned. Kicked out of the group, Lent is furious...until he discovers a hidden power to his Gift. Now, with his adorably devious fairy partner, he's going to claw back every last scrap of magic from his former party—with interest!  (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Shinja Zero no Megami-sama to Hajimeru Isekai Kouryaku
english_title: Full Clearing Another World under a Goddess with Zero Believers
japanese_title: 信者ゼロの女神サマと始める異世界攻略
synopsis: High school student and video game-lover Makoto Takatsuki dies in an accident and awakens in another world beside his classmates. However, he gains no cheat-like abilities, so he decides to become a "Magic Apprentice."  Then Noa, a minor goddess, appears before him. After she pleads and begs him, he decides to become her first believer. The weakest boy in the class becomes the strongest alongside the minor goddess in this another world fantasy!  (Source: Overlap, translated)

title: Gensou Suikoden
synopsis: Our story's hero and his friend Jowy are members of the Unicorn Youth Brigade, which participated in a drawn-out border dispute between the Highland Kingdom and the City- States of Jowstown. A few months earlier, a truth agreement was signed between the two forces, both of which were happy to see an end to the fighting. However, hidden under the momentary peace the fires of a new war continued to smolder...  (Source: ANN)

title: Keroro Gunsou☆
synopsis: A new Keroro Gunsou from scratch.

title: Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Kesshou Member Ketteisen
japanese_title: 新テニスの王子様 U-17 WORLD CUP 決勝メンバー決定戦
synopsis: Sequel to Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Semifinal.

title: Ghost Meets Gal!
japanese_title: ごーすと・みーつ・ぎゃる！
synopsis: Cardfight!! Vanguard spin-off centered on two girls aiming to become idols.  (Source: Official X Account)

title: Pan Dorobou
synopsis: The picture books center on a piece of bread that also steals bread from bakeries in the city.  (Source: ANN)

title: Norman the Snowman: Kodomo-tachi no Hitotsuboshi
japanese_title: ノーマン・ザ・スノーマン ~こどもたちのひとつ星~
synopsis: The boy has grown into a young man, living apart from his mother. Although he returned to his hometown, he is unable to be honest with her. After reuniting with Norman, a mysterious child searching for "snow flowers" suddenly appears before them. Norman and the young man venture into the snow-covered forest with the child.  (Source: Official site, translated)

title: Yuusanchi! from Yuu-hachi
japanese_title: ゆうさんち！from 遊ハち
synopsis: Yuu-hachi's Dekai Hachi; Miseban no Spis; and Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu manga all adapted into an omnibus short anime.  Dekai Hachi centers on a the titular character, a 40cm tall creature and his daily life alongside humans. Miseban no Spis centers on a mysterious fish that suddenly appears one day. Aa, Tanuki wa Mou Dame desu centers on a tanuki that is rented by various people.  (Source: ANN, edited)

title: Yuruyuru Zukan
synopsis: Gakken's hugely popular illustrated encyclopedia series, which everyone can enjoy with its laid-back four-panel comics, is finally being adapted into a TV anime!  Discover surprising aspects and fun facts about living creatures—full of secrets that will make you say, "Wow!"  Enjoy this new kind of anime that makes even scary things fun and easy to watch, with its cute art style.  (Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Punirunes: Puni 4
synopsis: Fourth season of Punirunes.

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Divinez Unmei Seisen-hen
japanese_title: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード DivineZ 運命星戦編
synopsis: Final Arc of Cardfight!! Vanguard: D Series.

title: Juuou Mujin Dandivine
japanese_title: 獣王武神ダンデヴァイン
synopsis: Twenty years have passed since the combining robot Dandivine defeated the mysterious invaders known as the Aposdoll. With the threat gone, the world has enjoyed a long era of peace. But for toy manufacturer Casga, whose fortunes were built on the popularity of Dandivine merchandise, that peace has come at a cost. Having relied too heavily on the legendary robot's fame, the company has steadily fallen into decline.  Desperate to revive both Dandivine and his struggling business, Casga's president, Genjurou Shijima, dreams of the robot's return—even if it means disrupting the peace. Then, as if in answer to his wish, the Aposdolls suddenly reappear in Tokyo.  As panic spreads among a population that has known nothing but peace for two decades, high school student Gekiha Shijima is recruited by his uncle, Yuusaku Kuroiwa, the former main pilot of Dandivine. Drawn into the cockpit of the legendary machine, Gekiha finds himself at the center of a new battle.  Why have the Aposdolls returned after all these years? And can Dandivine rise once again to face the threat? A new chapter in the fight for humanity is about to begin.  (Source: MAL News)

title: Kyoufu Collector
synopsis: The internet is full of creepypastas, cryptid sightings, tales of paranormal activity, and unsolved disappearances. These are mostly rumors and pranks fueled by trolls—entertainment. But the unlucky few learn the hard way that some legends are true. Many of these unfortunate souls are doomed, but their luck may change if they cross paths with the boy in the red hood. He roams from town to town and appears wherever strange things occur. Is he a light in the dark? Or living proof that monsters are all too real...?  (Source: Yen Press)

title: Marronnier Oukoku no Shichinin no Kishi
english_title: The Seven Knights of the Marronnier Kingdom
japanese_title: マロニエ王国の七人の騎士
synopsis: At the center of a continent made up of eight kingdoms lies the Kingdom of Marronnier. Leading the nation is the female general Baribara, who has seven sons, each with a personality all his own.  Sleepy, benevolent, sensitive to heat, sensitive to cold, gifted with animals, proud of his swordsmanship, and always hungry—the brothers possess very different qualities, but they are united by a single goal: "Someday, we'll rescue a princess in a cool way!"  Before long, the brothers set out for the seven neighboring kingdoms as ambassadors. What encounters, trials, and destinies await them in these unfamiliar lands?  Set in a medieval-inspired fantasy world, this tale of romance and adventure begins.  (Source: MAL News)

title: Soukou Kihei Votoms: Haiiro no Hexe
english_title: Armored Trooper Votoms: Die Graue Hexe
japanese_title: 装甲騎兵ボトムズ 灰色の魔女
synopsis: New Soukou Kihei Votoms anime, part of the Sunrise 50th Anniversary project.

synopsis: Second part of Mahou no Shimai Lulutto Lilly.

japanese_title: 魔法のプリンセス ミンキーモモ 憧れの夢へ まごころの二重奏
synopsis: A new original video anime for Mahou no Princess Minky Momo.

title: Maebashi Witches: Majo Minarai no Emoemories
japanese_title: 前橋ウィッチーズ ～魔女見習いのエモエモリーズ～
synopsis: Theatrical compilation of Maebashi Witches.

title: Disney Twisted-Wonderland The Animation: Episode of Savanaclaw
japanese_title: ディズニー ツイステッドワンダーランド ザ アニメーション エピソード オブ サバナクロー
synopsis: One day, high school student Yuuka "Yuu" Hirasaka finds herself transported to the world of Twisted Wonderland after a black carriage crashes into her. Though she hopes to return home to Tochigi in Japan, the magicless judo practitioner ends up enrolling in the prestigious magic academy Night Raven College.  As Yuu acclimates to her new life, the annual interdorm Spelldrive tournament at the school is set to begin. The team-based game tests the physical and magical strength of each dorm's seven best athletes, all while being broadcast throughout the magical world. For the past two years, the Diasomnia dorm has crushed the competition thanks solely to their powerful housewarden, Malleus Draconia.  Amidst the excitement, a series of incidents across campus befalling the top Spelldrive players from all dorms is rendering them unable to compete. Concerned that these are no mere accidents, the headmage of the academy tasks Yuu and her dormmate Grim to investigate. While the pair dives deeper into the matter, one housewarden in particular is determined to defeat Diasomnia—even if he must use underhanded methods to do so.  [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season Part 2
english_title: Ace of Diamond Act II Season 2 Part 2
japanese_title: ダイヤのA actⅡ Second Season 第2クール
synopsis: Part two of Diamond no Ace: Act II Second Season.

synopsis: Second season of Koori no Jouheki.

synopsis: Second season of Ao Ashi.

english_title: As a Reincarnated Aristocrat, I'll Use My Appraisal Skill to Rise in the World Season 3
japanese_title: 転生貴族、鑑定スキルで成り上がる 第3期
synopsis: Third season of Tensei Kizoku, Kantei Skill de Nariagaru.

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
japanese_title: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
synopsis: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, a project that was started a few years ago, is the newly ENHANCED edition of the anime Dragon Ball Super. ENHANCED by the latest visual expression, every scene, especially the battle scenes, is even more immersive, providing a more faithful and detailed reproduction of the original work by Akira Toriyama, and it will deliver a quality that is sure to fully satisfy audiences.  (Source: Official website)

title: Hotaru no Yomeiri
synopsis: Satoko, the eldest daughter of the honorable Kirigaya family, has received many marriage proposals from men captivated by her beauty and grace. However, she has turned them all down due to her secret heart defect. Despite her condition, Satoko is still willing to find a husband to ease her beloved father's concerns.  While on a stroll, Satoko is kidnapped by a group of mercenaries, one of them being Shinpei Gotou—a legendary assassin tasked with executing her. Satoko tries to bribe Gotou into freeing her, but it proves unsuccessful. Out of options, Satoko makes a desperate gamble: under the pretense of love at first sight, she asks him to marry her.  Unexpectedly, Gotou takes the bait and vows to protect her. As the couple escapes to freedom, Satoko struggles to keep up the ruse and make sense of the mysterious man she has eloped with.  [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka Part 2
english_title: Chitose Is in the Ramune Bottle Part 2
japanese_title: 千歳くんはラムネ瓶のなか 第2クール
synopsis: Second part of Chitose-kun wa Ramune Bin no Naka.

english_title: Tougen Anki: Nikko Kegon Falls Arc
japanese_title: 桃源暗鬼 日光・華厳の滝編
synopsis: Sequel of Tougen Anki.

japanese_title: 佐々木とピーちゃん シーズン２
synopsis: Second season of Sasaki to Pii-chan.

title: Mahoutsukai no Yoru
synopsis: Set near the end of the Showa period in the late 1980s, an old mansion in Misaki Town is rumored to be the home of a witch.  Aoko abruptly enters the world of magi after her grandfather suddenly decides to have Aoko become the Aozaki family's successor. Since then, Aoko moves into the Kuonji Mansion and begins to learn magecraft from the young magus Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. After witnessing the two using magecraft, Soujuurou Shizuki is also forced to live with them until a rune to remove his memories is discovered.   (Source: Type-Moon Fandom Wiki)

title: Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu 2nd Season
english_title: A Returner's Magic Should Be Special Season 2
japanese_title: 帰還者の魔法は特別です 2期
synopsis: Second season of Kikansha no Mahou wa Tokubetsu desu.

synopsis: Sequel to Made in Abyss: Retsujitsu no Ougonkyou.

synopsis: Second season of Tensei shitara Ken deshita.

japanese_title: ブラッククローバー 2nd season
synopsis: Second season of Black Clover.

title: Ao no Hako Season 2
synopsis: Second season of Ao no Hako.

japanese_title: 劇場版 薬屋のひとりごと 亡妃の秘宝
synopsis: Original Kusuriya no Hitorigoto movie.

japanese_title: 青春ブタ野郎はディアフレンドの夢を見ない
synopsis: Sequel to Seishun Buta Yarou wa Santa Claus no Yume wo Minai.

english_title: Tokyo Revengers: War of the Three Titan Arc
japanese_title: 東京リベンジャーズ 三天戦争編
synopsis: Sequel to Tokyo Revengers: Tenjiku-hen.

english_title: The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World II
japanese_title: 冰剣の魔術師が世界を統べるII
synopsis: Second season of Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu.

title: Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou Part 5
japanese_title: 『ガールズ＆パンツァー 最終章』第5話
synopsis: The fifth film in the six-part Girls & Panzer: Saishuushou film series.

title: Mezametara Saikyou Soubi to Uchuusenmochi Datta node, Ikkodate Mezashite Youhei toshite Jiyuu ni Ikitai
english_title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke Up Piloting the Strongest Starship!
japanese_title: 目覚めたら最強装備と宇宙船持ちだったので、一戸建て目指して傭兵として自由に生きたい
synopsis: Sato Takahiro was an ordinary office worker and hobbyist gamer until the day he woke up on a spaceship–one that strangely resembled a craft from a favorite space-shooter game. With a decked-out ship, a crew full of babes, and a fantastic universe to explore, he's going to make the most of his good luck and create the life he's always dreamed of!  (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Toaru Anbu no Item
japanese_title: とある暗部の少女共棲
synopsis: In Academy City, where supernatural abilities are part of everyday science, the city's peace is upheld by an unseen force—the dark side. Among the covert operatives is ITEM, a four-member elite unit. With Rikou Takitsubo's tracking abilities, Frenda Seivelun's explosive expertise, Saiai Kinuhata's impenetrable defense, and Shizuri Mugino's overwhelming power as one of Academy City's seven Level 5 espers, they navigate the city's underbelly, taking on secret missions that never make the headlines.  As their latest assignment unfolds, the team moves with precision, unaware that their actions are setting the stage for a tragedy that will test their bonds of trust, friendship, and survival in the unforgiving darkness of Academy City.  (Source: MAL News)

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
japanese_title: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
synopsis: Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.  Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.  [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
japanese_title: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
synopsis: Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.  However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.  Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.  (Source: MAL News)

title: Tempal: Item no Chikara
japanese_title: テムパル ～アイテムの力～
synopsis: Shin Youngwoo (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game "Satisfy," finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: "Pagma's Successor." He's now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game's most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for...  (Source: Tapas Media)

title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan
synopsis: When middle school student, Fukuga Kurumi's mother commits suicide after losing 20 million yen in FX trading (Foreign Exchange trading), she vows to recoup the money her mother lost "I'll easily get that much back!"  Now, when she is a university student she makes her long-awaited debut in FX trading, unaware that the world she just entered could turn from heaven to hell in the blink of an eye.  This is a cute and slightly dangerous story as it explains technical terms by thrilling market fluctuations as the chart drives up and down, which becomes more heated with the entry of quirky FX warriors: Yasuko Takane, Mochiko Kogane, and Mebuki Yamashi. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this world with unstoppable heartbeat moments and unrealized losses!?  (Source: MAL News)

title: Yowaki Max Reijou nanoni, Ratsuwan Konyakusha-sama no Kake ni Notte Shimatta
japanese_title: 弱気MAX令嬢なのに、辣腕婚約者様の賭けに乗ってしまった
synopsis: I was reborn as a villainous daughter in a reverse harem otome game.  After being sick with a high fever at the age of 10, Pia Rockwell suddenly remembered her past life as a university student in Japan. But far from going down the villainess route, all this super timid girl wants is to finally use her knowledge from when she was a grad student studying to get her doctorate in paleontology. Her ultimate goal is to become a commoner, excavate fossils, build a museum, and then become a curator.  So in order to escape the villainess route and avoid being deported by her fiancé during the graduation ball, Pia decides to avoid the upcoming hurt and heartache and asks to break off her engagement to Rufus, the Prime Minister's son.  But will her cunning fiancé let her go that easily?  (Source: MU)

title: Shuiro no Kamen
synopsis: The mask brings calamity. The mask revels in slaughter. The mask has a will of its own... Pelle, a traveling mask merchant, possesses the ability to craft mysterious masks that give its wearers unique powers. In a city shrouded in an eerie atmosphere, he encounters Sonah, a mysterious young girl. As revelations unfold and inner conflicts arise, a young boy takes his first steps forward! Immerse yourself in a thrilling mask battle fantasy!  (Source: Orange Inc.)

title: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku: Restart
japanese_title: 魔法少女育成計画 restart
synopsis: The deadly game is back!  Once again, sixteen Magical Girls have been assembled for a high-stakes challenge. Every three days, their Magical Phone pulls them into an RPG-like simulation where they have to work together to fight enemies, solve puzzles, and earn Magical Candy to advance. A staggering ten billion yen reward awaits them at the end—but only for the players who land the finishing blow. With such a tantalizing prize on the line, it's only a matter of time before the girls turn on each other—and if their hit points drop to zero, a game over will be the least of their worries...   (Source: Mahou Shoujo Ikusei Keikaku Wiki, edited)

title: Rakuen Tsuihou: Kokoro no Resonance
japanese_title: 楽園追放 心のレゾナンス
synopsis: Sequel to Rakuen Tsuihou.

title: Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru!
english_title: There Is Also a Hole in the Student Organization!
synopsis: Ume Mizunoe, a first-year student at the prestigious Fujinari Academy, excels in Japanese literature but struggles so badly in science that his chances of advancing are at risk. Hoping to boost his academic record, he joins the student council—only to find himself surrounded by a cast of quirky characters: a charismatic yet secretly shy president, a kind but intimidating treasurer, an adorably cheeky boy, and a tiny, stray-cat-like secretary.  Thrown into a whirlwind of chaotic daily life, Ume's school days are about to get a lot more unpredictable—and a lot more lively!  (Source: MAL News)

title: Tensei shita Daiseijo wa, Seijo de Aru Koto wo Hitakakusu
english_title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
japanese_title: 転生した大聖女は、聖女であることをひた隠す
synopsis: Fia always dreamed of becoming a knight. Born into a family of knights, she's the least talented among them, but she still clutches to her hope and trains with everything she has. When the day comes for her to slay a small demon and prove her worth, she ends up face to face with a dragon instead! A deadly injury makes her life flash before her eyes... and she suddenly remembers her former life, when she was a powerful Saint in a bygone era who defeated the Demon King. That life ended in pain because of who she was, making her fear ever becoming a Saint again. Now that the magic from her previous life has been rekindled, she may become a more powerful knight than she ever dreamed–if only she can survive long enough!  (Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.
english_title: I'm a Witch Who's Crush Requested a Love Potion
japanese_title: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
synopsis: Deep within the forest, a cozy and rather cluttered cottage sits on the lakeshore, housing a mysterious, feared witch. In truth, she is a lovely young woman named Rose, who has learned the art of potion-making from her wise grandmother. Rose cherishes her tucked-away life, yet there is a longing in her heart—for a handsome knight she once saw, Sir Harij Azm.  For four years, Rose's feelings for Harij have lingered, but she can never act on them; witches live outside of human affairs and belong to no country or man. So, when Harij suddenly appears on her doorstep looking for a love potion, Rose is both surprised and heartbroken. Although another woman has captured the noble knight's heart, Rose decides to help him. But before crafting the potion, Rose sends Harij on a series of ridiculous quests for each ingredient, hoping to delay the inevitable and savor their fleeting time together.  [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Psyren
synopsis: Ageha Yoshina is a self-confident high school student who helps others for a fee. On his way back from a job, he finds a strange calling card with the word "Psyren" imprinted left behind in a phone booth and decides to keep it, unaware of its purpose. The very next day, Ageha discovers that his classmate Sakurako Amamiya has the exact same calling card in her possession. When he questions her, Sakurako asks him to save her, signaling the day his troubles begin.  Confused by the circumstances of this encounter, Ageha realizes something is wrong when Sakurako goes missing. In an attempt to figure out what is happening, he decides to call the number provided on the calling card and is asked a series of questions by a mysterious voice, ending with a final, cryptic question: "Would you like to go to Psyren?" Thus begins two teenagers' participation in a game of life or death within a strange world inhabited by monsters called Taboo. Granted the ability to use psychic powers known as PSI, the duo fight to return to the place they call home.  [Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kusuriya no Hitorigoto 3rd Season
japanese_title: 薬屋のひとりごと 第3期
synopsis: In the aftermath of the Shi Clan's rebellion, things have finally settled down, and Maomao has returned to her old life as a pharmacist in the pleasure district. One day, triggered by a breakfast served at the Verdigris House, Maomao senses an anomaly and begins investigating its true nature. Meanwhile, Jinshi, who has revealed his true identity as the Imperial brother and begun to face his heavy responsibilities, is deeply troubled by the final message left by Loulan: a warning of an impending "disaster that will strike the nation." To make matters worse, rumors of a mysterious shrine maiden who deceives the people begin to spread, casting a dark shadow over the country of Li once again. From the depths of the inner court to the city streets, and across foreign borders—the world grows wider, and the stakes even higher for Maomao and Jinshi.  (Source: Crunchyroll)
